timing: Defined after data coverage checks and before the first return calculation.
reason: Upbit omits 5-minute candles with no trades. Every observed daily OHLCV aggregate matches its independent daily candle. Empty buckets are not filled with synthetic trade prices.
supersedes: The word contiguous in policy.json execution wording does not apply to no-trade gaps.
effective_execution: After a completed signal candle or daily boundary, use the first actual five-minute candle at or after the decision time, and only its opening price. Its precise first-trade timestamp and order-book depth are unavailable. Record bucket-level execution delay.
atr: ATR14 is computed on the 14-period sequence of actual Upbit 5-minute candles. Its wall-clock span can exceed 70 minutes. Use only ATR from before the just-completed signal candle; never add flat synthetic candles.
unchanged: Sample selection, entry rules, A/B/C/D thresholds, activation, horizon and costs remain exactly as frozen before data collection.
